thread:
maria: Quick sync — we need final landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private that lines up with launch posts and the webinar on Wed. Staggered demo cadence: Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private. Copy freeze EOD Mon. Who can own hero + CTA mapping?

alex: I can own hero + hero alt lines. Will consolidate existing variants and push one recommendation by tomorrow morning.

sam: I will draft the benchmark narrative for the webinar — short metric-driven paragraph and 2 customer vignettes. Need some baseline numbers (p50 latency, tokens/sec) — @alex, can you pull perf table?

jordan: Inbound routing recs: 3 lead funnels — 1) Try Hosted (self-serve) 2) Request Dedicated quote (sales) 3) Private consult (AE/SE). We need distinct CTAs and two different forms: lightweight trial form vs. enterprise intake. Also suggest hidden UTMs for source mapping.

kevin: Suggest we keep hero family tight. My quick options: 
- `Production LLM inference that scales with your costs`
- `Predictable LLM performance for product teams`
- `Ship LLM features: low latency, lower cost, higher uptime`
Pick one and tailor subcopy per mode.

maria: Good. Paste the three hero lines and add one-liners for each mode. Also include CTA text suggestions (button copy) and destination for routing. I'll run a 2pm copy review.

alex: Drafted hero + per-mode subcopy (first pass):
- Hosted hero: `Fastest way to ship LLM features`
  Hosted sub: "Hosted API with transparent pricing, streaming, and instant onboarding."
  CTA: `Start free trial` -> /signup?utm=hosted_trial
- Dedicated hero: `Reserved capacity for predictable throughput`
  Dedicated sub: "Dedicated GPU pools, SLA-backed latency, configurable autoscaling."
  CTA: `Request capacity quote` -> /sales/dedicated-intake
- Private hero: `Private deployment for regulated workloads`
  Private sub: "VPC/on-prem options, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs."
  CTA: `Contact enterprise team` -> /enterprise/intake

sam: Nice. For webinar benchmark narrative, draft paragraph: "In our internal benchmarks across x86 and A100/GPU instances, common RLHF-style chat loads saw median token latency of ~35ms and throughput improvements up to 3x with batching + KV cache. We’ll present a customer case: Acme.ai reduced inference cost-per-req by 42% after adopting caching + quantized model variants." Will add slides with raw numbers.

jordan: Routing logic details:
- Hosted CTA -> lightweight form -> auto-provision trial -> marketing automation sends onboarding series.
- Dedicated CTA -> 6-field sales intake -> routes to SDR pool A -> qualifying form triggers calendar link.
- Private CTA -> enterprise intake -> AE assignment + compliance checklist.
We should add hidden field `product_mode` to all forms to map conversions reliably.

kevin: A/B test idea: test hero variants across 3 cohorts (paid social, organic, webinar followup). Variant A = performance-first (kevin's lines), Variant B = economics-first ("lower cost"), Variant C = reliability-first (SLA wording). Run for 2 weeks post-launch.

maria: Agree. For the website copy pass I want: final hero, one supporting paragraph, 3 bullets (tech differentiators), CTA + routing, and microcopy for the top-of-funnel form. Keep language simple for PMs/engineers.

alex: Will deliver copy doc and annotated mockup by 10:30am tomorrow. I'll include recommended analytics events (`cta_click`, `form_submit`, `trial_started`) and the UTM schema.

ops-bot: Event created: "Copy review — landing + webinar alignment" Wed 14:00 UTC. Attendees: maria, alex, sam, jordan, kevin. Link: https://cal.example.com/1724689012

maria: Great — final asks before review: sam — bring 2 slide-level benchmark visuals; jordan — share intake form fields and routing matrix; alex — bring copy + mockup; kevin — list the 3 A/B test cohorts. See you all at 2pm. :thumbsup:
